name: Jana Novotná
bio:
Jana Novotná brings over 15 years of financial management experience to Prema Junior, having previously worked in the corporate finance sector before transitioning to motorsport. A lifelong racing enthusiast, she saw an opportunity to combine her professional expertise with her passion for speed and competition. Jana is meticulous in her approach, emphasizing transparency and fiscal responsibility to ensure the team operates within budget and maximizes its resources.

Her key strength lies in her ability to identify potential cost-saving measures and negotiate favorable contracts with suppliers. She is dedicated to providing the team with the financial stability needed to invest in crucial upgrades and development programs. Jana firmly believes that a financially sound team is a competitive team.

Distinctive for her proactive approach and dedication to accuracy, Jana is always seeking ways to optimize financial processes and streamline operations. Her focus on long-term financial planning and prudent resource allocation makes her an invaluable asset to Prema Junior.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Jana has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always has a spreadsheet open, even during lunch.
Drinks copious amounts of herbal tea throughout the day.
Insists on using a specific brand of calculator.
